CBX01-020.name: Millennium
CBX01-020.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Barrage: Cost 4 or less]
This Nexus is unaffected by opposing Cost 4 or less effects.

[LV1][LV2] Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
You can summon a Cost 4 or less "Compass" family Spirit card from your Hand, treating all its reduction symbols as fulfilled.

[LV2]
(Can't Stack) When your "Compass" family Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, if the number of cards in your Hand is equal or inferior to the opponent's, you can draw a card.

CBX01-013.name: Agnes Giebenrath
CBX01-013.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can summon one "Kira Yamato" from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by returning another "Compass" family Spirit/Brave you control to the deckbottom, this Spirit refreshes.

CBX01-019.name: Birdy & Blue
CBX01-019.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck via your "Compass" family effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[Mirage: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Compass" family Spirit attacks, you can put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

[LV1]
All your braved "Compass" family Braves are unaffected by opposing effects.

CBX01-X01.name: Black Knight Squad Cal-re.A
CBX01-X01.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit attacks]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, by placing up to three cards from your decktop onto the Field facedown and putting one core from the Reserve onto each of them, until the end of the game, those cards are treated as White Spirits with: "Cost 0/"Foundation" family/<1>LV1 BP 5000/[White Core]". (The facedown Spirits can't be braved/advented on/switched in places)

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
By returning a facedown Spirit you control to the Hand, return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

CBX01-017.name: Athrun Zala ［C.E. 75］
CBX01-017.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
(Once per Game: Same Name) If you have four counters or more, you can put a core from the Void to your Life.

[During Brave] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Compass" family Spirit attacks, send three cores from an opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void, and during that battle, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

CBX01-021.name: Compulsory Observational Making Peace Service, Compass
CBX01-021.effect:
This card in Trash is unaffected by any effects.

When this card is revealed from the deck via your "Compass" family effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([White Core][White Core])]
[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
While your Life is at one, all your originally Cost 8 or more "Compass" family Spirit gain an extra White symbol.

[Flash]
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Freedom", during this turn, your Life can only be reduced by one.

CBX01-011.name: Destiny Gundam Spec II
CBX01-011.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Freedom", during this turn, every opposing Spirit/Ultimate must attack if possible.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [VPSa: Cost 7 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 7 or less effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit gains +1000 BP for each counter you have.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block while exhausted.

CBX01-006.name: Duel Blitz Gundam
CBX01-006.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this card is revealed from deck by your "Compass" family effect, you can pay one cost to summon it.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Discard an opposing Burst, and when you couldn't discard, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [VPSa: Cost 5 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 5 or less effects.

CBX01-008.name: Force Impulse Gundam Spec II
CBX01-008.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Compass & C2 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Either return an opposing Brave/Nexus to the deckbottom, or discard an opposing Burst.

[LV2] [VPSa: Cost 5 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 5 or less effects.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, you can send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to the Reserve.

CBX01-001.name: Gelgoog Menace ［General Use］
CBX01-001.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your "Compass" family Spirit [Contract Advents], you can summon this card from the Hand without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing End Step)
If you have any "Compass" family Brave/Nexus/Mirage, you can +1 counter.

CBX01-002.name: Gelgoog Menace ［Lunamaria Use］
CBX01-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void each to your Trash and another "Compass" family Spirit/Nexus you control.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting this Spirit, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

CBX01-004.name: Gyan Storm ［Agnes Use］
CBX01-004.effect:
During your Main Step, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Freedom"/"Kira Yamato", you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
By returning another "Compass" family Spirit/Brave you control to the deckbottom, draw a card.

CBX01-005.name: Gyan Storm ［Hilda Use］
CBX01-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can summon a Cost 6 or less "Compass" family card from your Trash/Soul State. When you've done so, your counter +1.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. Or, if there are two or more "Compass" family Spirit cards in your Trash, you can return an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit to the deckbottom.

CBX01-003.name: Immortal Justice Gundam
CBX01-003.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Compass, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, besides "Immortal Justice Gundam", add a "Compass" family card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2] [VPSa: Cost 5 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 5 or less effects.

CBX01-X02.name: Infinite Justice Gundam Type II
CBX01-X02.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, for each "Compass" family Spirit you control, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [VPSa: Cost 7 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 7 or less effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Put two cores from the Void to your other "Compass" family Spirits/Nexuses.

CBX01-015.name: Kira Yamato ［C.E. 75］
CBX01-015.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Lacus Clyne", and a "Compass" family card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can return any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates, up to a total of (this Spirit's BP) BP, to the deckbottom.

CBX01-012.name: Lacus Clyne ［C.E. 75］
CBX01-012.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

One copy of this card/Brave can brave to a Spirit you control that's braved to a "Kira Yamato", ignoring the number of Braves on it.

[LV1]
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any "Freedom", this Spirit-condition Brave is unaffected by opposing effects.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.

CBX01-007.name: Lightning Buster Gundam
CBX01-007.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this card is revealed from deck by your "Compass" family effect, you can pay one cost to summon it.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Blocks)
You can return an opposing Nexus to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [VPSa: Cost 5 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 5 or less effects.

CBX01-014.name: Lunamaria Hawke ［C.E. 75］
CBX01-014.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void each to this Spirit and a Spirit braved to "Shinn Asuka" you control. Also, while this Spirit is Cost 7 or less, this Brave's symbol is fixed as zero.

CBX01-X03.name: Mighty Strike Freedom Gundam
CBX01-X03.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Compass & C7 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] [VPSa: Cost 7 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 7 or less effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked. Also, return up to two opposing Spirits/Ultimates/Nexuses to the deckbottom.

[During OC & During Advent & During Brave] [LV2] (When Attacks)
While braved to "Kira Yamato" and "Lacus Clyne", the opponent can't use cards from the Hand/Removed Zone.

CBX01-018.name: Orphee Lam Tao
CBX01-018.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Besides "Orphee Lam Tao", put a core from the Void each to every "Foundation" family Spirit you control.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by exhausting a White-only Spirit you control, refresh this Spirit.

CBX01-016.name: Shinn Asuka ［C.E. 75］
CBX01-016.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

(Can't Stack) During either Attack Step, when your "Compass" family Spirit is summoned/[Contract Advents], you can immediately summon this card from your Hand by paying one cost.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. Also, once per turn, when only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, this Spirit can refresh.

CBX01-010.name: Strike Freedom Gundam Type II
CBX01-010.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Compass & C4 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
During this turn, the effects of an opposing Spirit can't activate. Then, return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2] [VPSa: Cost 7 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 7 or less effects.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, immediately end the Attack Step.

CBX01-CX01.name: Rising Freedom Gundam
CBX01-CX01.effect:
While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2. Then, you can return an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's to the deckbottom.

[LV2] [VPSa: Cost 5 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 5 or less effects.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV2]
Once per turn, when your other "Compass" family Spirit is exhausted, this Spirit can refresh.
